tables.name: body_daily
tables.doc: One row per day of body measurements, usually from a watch or phone.

tables.name: workouts
tables.doc: Each workout with its start and end, e.g. from Apple Fitness or a watch. The day ring and Review use the times; body_daily.workout_min is the daily total. A workout paused along the way can be one row per stretch of moving (the Apple Health importer writes it so), so the minutes are the time spent moving. `end` must be after `start`.

tables.name: meals
tables.doc: What you ate, one row per meal or snack, e.g. from a food-logging app that writes to Apple Health. A day with no rows was not logged: it is unknown, never zero calories. A day counts as logged once it has at least two main meals (breakfast, lunch, dinner); with fewer it is shown but not averaged. A meal before 4 am counts for the day before; a time of exactly 00:00 is read as a date without a time (what a date-only export gives) and counts for its own day.

tables.name: self_report
tables.doc: How you said you felt. Optional; pages show a prompt when it is empty. `feel` is the Recovery page's morning check-in; energy and focus are typed by hand or written by an assistant.

tables.name: soreness
tables.doc: Where it was sore on a day and how much, one row per region. You say it when you feel it (Recovery's "Where does it hurt?", in a sentence, typed or spoken), and the next days the page asks about it until you say it is fine (level 0). A region without a row that day was not said: unknown, never "not sore". Older files may hold a morning check-in's region `none` (nothing sore) and the first figure's seven regions (head, torso, pelvis, left_calf, right_calf, and the upper arms); they are read as they are. You can also write it by hand or import a CSV.

tables.name: workout_notes
tables.doc: What a workout trained: the regions (the soreness regions) and a note in your own words (typed, or dictated with the phone keyboard's microphone). After a strength session or a hard one (effort 7 or more) the pages ask once. A row with no regions and no note means you chose not to say.

tables.name: screen_sessions
tables.doc: Foreground app sessions across your devices. Overlaps between devices are allowed; Health AIO counts wall-clock time once, preferring the device order in healthaio.toml (the Stimulation page's devices-at-once tab counts each device on its own). `end` must be after `start`.

tables.name: events
tables.doc: Calendar blocks: classes, work shifts, planned training.

tables.name: deadlines
tables.doc: Things due on a date: assignments, exams, milestones.
